name: LinkedWing Co-Pilot
desc: An AI co-pilot takes the helm of this hull in combat. Install it, launch a battle, and the assistant flies this ship alongside you. Press F1 in battle to cycle: AUTOPILOT (vanilla AI) - WING (LLM flies this hull) - FLEET (LLM flies this hull and directs your wing). The co-pilot asks questions as floating text; answer with the number keys while it is waiting.
short: Your AI wingmate flies this hull; F1 cycles authority; answer floating-text questions with 1-4.
